name: Rust
description: Rust compiled ahead-of-time by rustc (LLVM). Memory safety without a garbage collector.

variants.name: rustc -C opt-level=3
variants.description: Equivalent to cargo build --release with the default codegen settings.

variants.name: rustc -C opt-level=3 -C target-cpu=native
variants.build: mkdir -p {bin}.d && cp {harness}/harness.rs {bin}.d/main.rs && cp {src}/main.rs {bin}.d/problem.rs && rustc --edition 2021 -C opt-level=3 -C target-cpu=native -o {bin} {bin}.d/main.rs

variants.name: rustc -C opt-level=3 -C codegen-units=1 -C lto
variants.description: Single codegen unit with link-time optimisation.
variants.build: mkdir -p {bin}.d && cp {harness}/harness.rs {bin}.d/main.rs && cp {src}/main.rs {bin}.d/problem.rs && rustc --edition 2021 -C opt-level=3 -C codegen-units=1 -C lto -o {bin} {bin}.d/main.rs
